scene.head: with_body
scene.placeText: the long gaslit rolling room of a grand cigar factory of pale stone in her steam city — rows of rollers at wooden benches heaped with silky tobacco leaves, brass gaslamps and tall arched windows, a reader reading aloud from a raised brass-railed platform and Spanish-cedar boxes stacked along the walls
scene.ownProp: a half-rolled cigar wrapped in a broad, silky tobacco wrapper leaf
scene.outfit: a cigar-roller look fitted to her body — a sleeveless corset bodice of tobacco-brown silk veined like a wrapper leaf, high-waisted shorts, a wide red sash embossed with plain gold scrollwork wound like a cigar band, a short cedar-brown leather work apron with a pocket of crescent knives and laced ankle boots
scene.scene: she is a master cigar roller, leaning over her wooden bench and rolling a broad silky wrapper leaf tight around the bunch with both hands, her crescent knife of polished steel set down beside the cedar boxes, as she listens to the reader's voice
